title.en: An Act Declaring April 24 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Municipality of Sulop, Province of Davao Del Sur, to Be Known as "Araw Ng Sulop", in Commemoration of Its Foundation Anniversary
title.orig: An Act Declaring April 24 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Municipality of Sulop, Province of Davao Del Sur, to Be Known as "Araw Ng Sulop", in Commemoration of Its Foundation Anniversary
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 24 tháng 4 hằng năm là ngày làm việc lễ đặc biệt tại Đô thị Sulop, Tỉnh Davao Del Sur với tên gọi "Araw Ng Sulop", nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 24 เมษายนของทุกปีเป็นวันทำงานพิเศษในเทศบาล Sulop จังหวัด Davao Del Sur ในชื่อ "Araw Ng Sulop" เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 24 April setiap tahun sebagai hari kerja khusus di Kotamadya Sulop, Provinsi Davao Del Sur dengan nama "Araw Ng Sulop", dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 24 April setiap tahun sebagai hari bekerja khas di Perbandaran Sulop, Wilayah Davao Del Sur dengan nama "Araw Ng Sulop", sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan

text.en: April 24 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday in the Municipality of Sulop, Province of Davao del Sur, to be known as "Araw ng Sulop ", in commemoration of its foundation anniversary. However, upon proclamation of the President, April 24 of every year shall be a special non-working holiday in the Municipality of Sulop, Province of Davao del Sur.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
